bio: A fine addition to Karlsruhe's culinary scene. Chef-patron Mario Aliberti fuses Italian cuisine with international – especially Asian – and regional influences. A wide range of dishes is available: Lunchtime features four different moderately priced set menus (individual courses can also be ordered separately), along with additional à la carte options. In the evening, the array of options includes the Fine Dining Menu, the Italian Menu and the Menü Sharing, as well as an extensive à la carte selection. You can also order whole fish and different cuts of meat. There really is something for everyone's taste! The well-stocked wine list is worth a look, too.
